finding.headline: "The First-12-Weeks Capsule"
finding.problem: "Just tell me what to buy. I'm tired, I'm pregnant, I don't have time to become a baby-gear expert. Give me the 40 things and let me be done."
finding.person: Overwhelmed mum who doesn't want to research; wants one trusted list of exactly what to buy for weeks 0–12 and nothing else.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone (the core "New Parent Minimalist Setup" product).". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
